crops.name: Oakhaven Great Oak
crops.description: The iconic ancient oak of Oakhaven valley. Sturdy hardwood canopy providing essential construction lumber.
crops.harvest_note: Chop down for Oak Wood (12-16) + Firewood. Attach an Artisan Tapper to harvest Dark Oak Resin every 7 days.

crops.name: Alpine Pine
crops.description: Evergreen conifer standing tall against alpine blizzards. Yields flexible timber and aromatic protective pitch.
crops.harvest_note: Chop down for Pine Wood (12-16). Attach an Artisan Tapper to harvest Alpine Pine Tar every 5 days.

crops.name: Ember Maple
crops.description: Magnificent maple whose foliage bursts into glowing crimson and amber in autumn. Source of prized tavern pancake syrup.
crops.harvest_note: Chop down for Ember Maple Timber. Attach an Artisan Tapper to produce Amber Maple Syrup every 9 days.

crops.name: Silver Birch
crops.description: Slender silvery-barked tree that grows rapidly. Silky waterproof bark is harvested for crafting and scrolls.
crops.harvest_note: Chop down for Silver Birch Timber and Bark Rolls. Tap to collect Pure Birch Sap every 6 days.

crops.name: River Willow
crops.description: Graceful weeping willow flanking Oakhaven's riverbanks. Flexible boughs weave sturdy baskets; bitter sap eases fever.
crops.harvest_note: Harvest for flexible Willow Branches. Tap with an Artisan Tapper for Medicinal Willow Sap every 6 days.

crops.name: Abyssal Ironwood
crops.description: Legendary black timber tree with fibers denser than raw iron. Requires an Iron Axe or superior tool to chop down.
crops.harvest_note: Requires Iron Axe+. Yields Abyssal Ironwood Timber. Tap to collect rust-preventing Ironwood Oil every 10 days.

crops.name: Oakhaven Honey Apple Tree
crops.description: Famous heirloom orchard tree. Takes 28 days to mature from sapling with a 3x3 clear radius. Lives permanently without watering.
crops.harvest_note: Bears 1 crisp apple every morning throughout Autumn (or year-round in Greenhouse). Quality ages with tree maturity.

crops.name: Spark Lemon Tree
crops.description: Vibrant citrus tree basking in intense summer sunlight. Yields tangy electrifying lemons that awaken the senses.
crops.harvest_note: Requires 3x3 clear space. Produces 1 Spark Lemon daily in Summer. Core ingredient for chilled teas and savory marinades.

crops.name: Frost Plum Tree
crops.description: Miraculous orchard tree that blossoms and fruits through biting winter blizzards. Yields frosty violet plums with wine-red flesh.
crops.harvest_note: Requires 3x3 clearance. Yields 1 Frost Plum daily throughout Winter. Grants temporary winter chill resistance.

crops.name: Blossom Peach Tree
crops.description: Fragrant pink-blossomed tree announcing Spring's arrival. Produces velvety sweet peaches bursting with floral nectar.
crops.harvest_note: Requires 3x3 clear space. Bears 1 Blossom Peach every morning during Spring. Ideal for morning breakfast preserves.

crops.name: Crimson Cherry Tree
crops.description: Radiant cherry tree with shimmering crimson fruit clusters. Spring blooms draw wild honeybees across the valley.
crops.harvest_note: Requires 3x3 clearance. Yields 1 cluster of sweet cherries every Spring morning. Perfect for tarts and cordials.

crops.name: Oakhaven Walnut Tree
crops.description: Spreading walnut tree yielding nutrient-dense, buttery nuts that sustain townsfolk through autumn and winter.
crops.harvest_note: Requires 3x3 clearance. Drops hearty walnuts daily in Autumn. Ground into trail meal or roasted for high stamina.

crops.name: Misty Pear Tree
crops.description: Golden pear tree that flourishes in the crisp misty mornings of late autumn. Yields refreshingly crisp fruit.
crops.harvest_note: Requires 3x3 clearance. Bears 1 Misty Pear daily in Autumn. Poached in mulled red wine at the tavern.

crops.name: Ember Orange Tree
crops.description: Citrus tree laden with glowing amber-orange fruit. Soaks in summer heat to produce rich revitalizing juice.
crops.harvest_note: Requires 3x3 clearance. Bears 1 Ember Orange daily in Summer. Squeezed fresh for travelers arriving at the inn.

crops.name: Silver Wheat
crops.description: Hardy versatile grain spanning three seasons. Ground at the windmill into Fresh Flour for bakery recipes.
crops.harvest_note: Single harvest. Mill at the Windmill to obtain Fresh Flour.

crops.name: Crisp Ice Cabbage
crops.description: Crisp, tightly wrapped heads thriving in morning chill; 2% chance to fuse into a Giant Ice Cabbage in 3x3 plots.
crops.harvest_note: Single harvest. Excellent for light tavern broths and crisp slaws.

crops.name: Spring Wildberry
crops.description: Sweet-tart red berry bush that continues to fruit every 3 days throughout Spring.
crops.harvest_note: Regrows every 3 days. Provides steady recurring profits all Spring.

crops.name: Trellis Sweet Pea
crops.description: Climbing pea vine requiring a wood trellis. Bears plump emerald pods packed with tender sweet peas.
crops.harvest_note: Requires trellis post (blocks player path). Regrows sweet pods every 3 days.

crops.name: Sen Tea Blossom Bush
crops.description: Precious perennial tea bush soaked in dawn mist. Produces fragrant lotus-scented tea leaves.
crops.harvest_note: Regrows every 4 days across Spring and Summer. Foundation of the tavern's herbal tea menu.

crops.name: Sun Daisy
crops.description: Bright golden daisy petals that absorb radiant warmth. Brewed into calming tea and fine fabric dyes.
crops.harvest_note: Single harvest. Key ingredient for Honey Chamomile Tea.

crops.name: Sun Corn
crops.description: Towering corn stalks with sweet golden kernels. Highly profitable crop spanning Summer and Autumn.
crops.harvest_note: Regrows fresh cobs every 4 days through Summer and Autumn without replanting.

crops.name: Juicy Fire Tomato
crops.description: Summer tomato vine bearing deep red savory fruits. Crucial base for savory stews and sauces.
crops.harvest_note: Regrows clusters every 4 days after first harvest.

crops.name: Magma Melon
crops.description: Giant melon with glowing red-amber flesh. Packed with refreshing sweetness and intense vitality.
crops.harvest_note: Single harvest. 2% chance to merge into a Giant Crop when planted in a 3x3 grid.

crops.name: Amber Honey Cane
crops.description: Sweet purple sugar cane infused with wild honey flavor. Processed into raw sugar for bakery delicacies.
crops.harvest_note: Single harvest. Process into Raw Sugar at the artisan station.

crops.name: Shadow Carrot
crops.description: Dark purple carrot with luminous orange core. Sharpens nocturnal vision inside gloomy mine shafts.
crops.harvest_note: Single harvest. Plantable in both Summer and Autumn.

crops.name: Whisper Ginger
crops.description: Fiery spicy ginger root that brings comforting heat to cold-weather braises and broths.
crops.harvest_note: Single harvest. Essential seasoning for tavern hearty beef stews.

crops.name: Golden Sunflower
crops.description: Tall cheerful sunflower that drops 1-2 bonus seeds upon harvest for effortless sustained replanting.
crops.harvest_note: Harvest drops bonus seeds. Viable throughout Summer and Autumn.

crops.name: Sweet Honey Pumpkin
crops.description: Massive honey-sweet pumpkin with dense golden flesh. High-value crop celebrating the autumn harvest.
crops.harvest_note: Single harvest. 2% chance to become a Giant Pumpkin in 3x3 plots (axe fells 15-20 pumpkins).

crops.name: Shadow Rye
crops.description: Fast-growing dark purple rye adapted to crisp autumn winds. Baked into artisanal rustic rye loaves.
crops.harvest_note: Single harvest. Superfast 5-day growth cycle.

crops.name: Trellis Night Grape
crops.description: Moonlit purple grapevines trained onto sturdy trellises. Vintage fruit fermented into tavern reserve wines.
crops.harvest_note: Requires trellis post. Regrows succulent clusters every 3 days in Autumn.

crops.name: Moonlight Yam
crops.description: Silvery-skinned violet sweet potato. Hearth-roasted on open embers for irresistible tavern snacks.
crops.harvest_note: Single harvest. Beloved comfort food gift for town residents.

crops.name: Misty Lavender
crops.description: Fragrant purple lavender blooms from misty hillsides, dried for soothing herbal tea and refreshing inn pillows.
crops.harvest_note: Single harvest. Boosts cleanliness and comfort ratings of tavern inn rooms.

crops.name: Frost Turnip
crops.description: Frost-hardy white turnip (1 of 3 outdoor Winter crops); 2% chance to fuse into a Giant Snow Turnip in 3x3 plots.
crops.harvest_note: Single harvest. Fastest winter cash crop (5-day growth cycle).

crops.name: Dewdrop Mint
crops.description: Crisp, cooling aromatic mint grown across Spring & Summer for refreshing teas and pastilles.
crops.harvest_note: Single harvest. Brewed into steam-inhalation remedies for winter colds.

crops.name: Highland Potato
crops.description: Hearty spring-grown mountain potatoes; mashed with garlic butter for blacksmith Boris's favorite side dish.
crops.harvest_note: Single harvest. Often yields multiple tubers per harvest.

crops.name: Ruby Beet
crops.description: Autumn-harvested crimson roots rich in natural sugars for hearty borscht and festive bakes.
crops.harvest_note: Single harvest. Natural deep red dye for bakery icing and tavern stews.

crops.name: Glacial Lichen Root
crops.description: Ancient glacial lichen root harvested beneath hard ice sheets. Prized medicinal herb for resilience draughts.
crops.harvest_note: Single harvest. Fetches premium prices from town apothecaries.

crops.name: Millennial Frost Lotus
crops.description: Crystalline lotus blooming atop thin frozen marsh waters. Legendary winter botanic treasure.
crops.harvest_note: Single harvest. Must be planted near water tiles. Highest winter farming profit.

crops.name: Sopophorous Bean Vine
crops.description: Mystical silver-podded bean vine yielding luminous seeds that banish weariness through the night.
crops.harvest_note: Regrows every 3 days across Spring, Summer, and Autumn. Key alchemy ingredient.

crops.name: Mandrake Root
crops.description: Prized humanoid root grown in Autumn (or year-round in the Greenhouse); stewed into boss combat vitality broths.
crops.harvest_note: Single harvest. Thrives in both Autumn and harsh Winter soil.

crops.name: Inoculated Mushroom Log
crops.description: Shaded timber log inoculated with mushroom spores. Produces fresh woodland mushrooms year-round without watering.
crops.harvest_note: Regrows mushrooms every 4 days all four seasons. Chance for Lumina Shrooms if placed in caves.

crops.name: Valley Paddy Rice
crops.description: High-yield paddy rice cultivated on Region 2 Rice Terraces (absorbs flooded terrace water automatically without daily hand-watering). Milled into Valley Rice for rice balls, fried rice, and sticky rice.
crops.harvest_note: Harvests in 6 days; auto-irrigated when planted on flooded Rice Terraces.

crops.name: Valley Scallion
crops.description: Fastest-growing valley herb; regrows crisp green stalks for stir-fries, omelets, and broths.
crops.harvest_note: Regrows every 2 days throughout Spring.

crops.name: Valley Spinach
crops.description: Tender iron-rich leafy greens great for garlic sautés and savory pastry fillings.
crops.harvest_note: Single harvest after 4 days.

crops.name: Silver Flax
crops.description: Industrial fiber crop supplying Elora & Mae's looms with tough linen thread for ropes and canvas.
crops.harvest_note: Harvests flax fibers and oilseeds.

crops.name: Crispy Jícama
crops.description: Crisp, juicy Mexican turnip-root with sweet apple-like crunch; 2% chance to fuse into a Giant 3x3 Jícama.
crops.harvest_note: Plant in 3x3 clusters for Giant Spring Jícama.

crops.name: Spring Asparagus
crops.description: Slender emerald spears harvested repeatedly; butter-seared alongside steaks.
crops.harvest_note: Regrows every 3 days after first cut.

crops.name: Sweet Bamboo Shoot
crops.description: Grown near streams; yields tender edible shoots and hollow bamboo tubes for Bamboo-Roasted Rice.
crops.harvest_note: Regrows every 4 days across Spring.

crops.name: Globe Artichoke
crops.description: Ornamental purple-green thistle bud simmered into poison-cleansing broths.
crops.harvest_note: Plantable in both Spring & Summer.

crops.name: Highland Coffee
crops.description: Highland coffee shrub yielding berries across Spring & Summer; roasted into speed-boosting hot coffee.
crops.harvest_note: Regrows berries every 2 days across Spring & Summer.

crops.name: Hearth Red Chili
crops.description: Fiery red chili pods powering spicy hotpots, stir-fries, and grilled meats.
crops.harvest_note: Regrows every 3 days across Summer.

crops.name: Dusk Eggplant
crops.description: Glossy deep-violet eggplants delicious grilled with scallions or braised with rice.
crops.harvest_note: Regrows every 4 days.

crops.name: Horned Kiwano Melon
crops.description: Striking trellised orange horned melon with emerald jelly flesh; refreshing citrus-melon tang.
crops.harvest_note: Trellis vine (blocks walking).

crops.name: Earth-Almond Chufa
crops.description: Ancient sedge tubers tasting of sweet roasted almonds; pressed for plant milk and trail cookies.
crops.harvest_note: Single harvest after 7 days.

crops.name: Golden Turmeric
crops.description: Vibrant orange spice root coloring festival rice and Aurelia's recovery salves.
crops.harvest_note: Single harvest after 7 days.

crops.name: Valley Cassava
crops.description: Drought-resilient starchy root refined into cooling summer drinks and chewy dumplings.
crops.harvest_note: Plantable in Summer & Autumn.

crops.name: Black Pepper Vine
crops.description: Trellised peppercorn vine letting Rowan farm aromatic black pepper for steaks and sausages.
crops.harvest_note: Trellis vine, harvests peppercorns every 3 days.

crops.name: Frontier Purple Garlic
crops.description: Pungent purple-skinned garlic essential for steaks, buttered potatoes, and braised squid.
crops.harvest_note: Quick 5-day Autumn harvest.

crops.name: Golden Valley Onion
crops.description: Sweet golden-skinned onions storing well through Winter for stews and sausages.
crops.harvest_note: Harvests after 6 days.

crops.name: Tavern Hops
crops.description: Tall aromatic hops trellis brewed into craft tavern ales in oak casks.
crops.harvest_note: Trellis vine, regrows every 2 days.

crops.name: Golden Soybean
crops.description: Versatile golden beans milled into soy milk, tofu, and fermented tavern bean paste.
crops.harvest_note: Regrows every 3 days.

crops.name: Hearth Rosemary
crops.description: Aromatic evergreen herb sprigs for roasting poultry, steaks, and perfuming inn rooms.
crops.harvest_note: Regrows every 3 days.

crops.name: Turban Squash
crops.description: Colorful heirloom squash shaped like a bumpy turban; great for creamy soups and Masquerade decor.
crops.harvest_note: Plantable in Summer & Autumn.

crops.name: Andean Jewel Oca
crops.description: Glossy jewel-toned Andean tubers with bright citrus-potato flavor; loved by Cora and Bram.
crops.harvest_note: Harvests after 7 days.

crops.name: Oyster Salsify
crops.description: Heirloom root tasting delicately of oysters when simmered in creamy chowders.
crops.harvest_note: Harvests after 8 days.

crops.name: Saffron Crocus
crops.description: Precious crimson stigmas from autumn crocus blooms, elevating dishes to Royal Contest 5-star quality.
crops.harvest_note: High seed cost with premier Autumn profit.

crops.name: Gold Kiwifruit
crops.description: Trellised golden-fleshed kiwifruit packed with stamina-restoring tang.
crops.harvest_note: Trellis vine, harvests every 3 days.

crops.name: Bay Laurel
crops.description: Fragrant Mediterranean laurel leaves for wine stews and woven champion wreaths.
crops.harvest_note: Grows in Spring & Autumn; regrows every 4 days.

crops.name: Terrace Mud Lotus Root
crops.description: Region 2 flooded terrace crop (auto-irrigated); crisp perforated roots for Altar purification feasts.
crops.harvest_note: Grow on Region 2 flooded Rice Terraces.

crops.name: Terrace Purple Taro
crops.description: Region 2 terrace taro root; authentic base for Hearth-Steamed Ash Taro Cakes.
crops.harvest_note: Grow on Region 2 flooded Rice Terraces.

crops.name: Ancient Forest Ube
crops.description: Region 3 Eternal Forest vine yam with vanilla-nutty purple flesh for specialty desserts.
crops.harvest_note: Unlocked upon purifying Region 3 Herb Forest.

crops.name: Deepwood Vanilla Orchid
crops.description: Region 3 climbing orchid yielding fragrant vanilla pods for high-tier bakery recipes.
crops.harvest_note: Regrows every 4 days in Region 3 Forest.

crops.name: Wolf-Tooth Snow Maca
crops.description: Region 4 Wolf-Tooth Peak highland tuber thriving in sub-zero cliffs; boosts Stamina & Cold Resistance.
crops.harvest_note: Plantable only on Region 4 Wolf-Tooth Peak.

crops.name: Alpine Snow Lotus
crops.description: Region 4 alpine bloom thriving near hot springs; key reagent for revival and cure-all elixirs.
crops.harvest_note: Grown beside Region 4 Mountain Hot Springs.

crops.name: Glow-Fern Cave Tuber
crops.description: Subterranean dark-cave tuber needing zero sunlight; eating grants a soft cave illumination aura.
crops.harvest_note: Plantable in dark cellar / cave beds.

crops.name: Cavern Black Truffle
crops.description: Rare subterranean black truffle cultivated in damp cave soil; prized 5-star Royal Banquet ingredient.
crops.harvest_note: Cultivated in dark damp cave soil without watering.

crops.name: Roasted Chestnut Tree
crops.description: Hardy deep-rooted tree dropping sweet chestnuts roasted beside The Hearth's winter fire.
crops.harvest_note: Requires 3x3 clear space; fruits in Autumn & Winter.

crops.name: Ancient Olive Tree
crops.description: Pressed into Virgin Olive Oil for cooking sautés and salads without relying on dairy butter.
crops.harvest_note: Requires 3x3 clear space; fruits in Summer & Autumn.

crops.name: Valley Cacao Tree
crops.description: Ground into rich cocoa for cozy winter Hot Chocolate and gourmet patisserie.
crops.harvest_note: Requires 3x3 clear space; fruits in Summer or Greenhouse.

crops.name: Solaria Pomegranate Tree
crops.description: Ruby-seeded fruit pressed into vitality elixirs boosting Max HP and Critical Hit Rate.
crops.harvest_note: Requires 3x3 clear space; fruits in Autumn.

crops.name: Honey Fig Tree
crops.description: Sweet purple figs simmered into preserves served with oak-aged cheese.
crops.harvest_note: Requires 3x3 clear space; fruits in Autumn.

crops.name: Golden Apricot Tree
crops.description: Sun-gold apricots dried into non-perishable trail rations for 150-floor mine delves.
crops.harvest_note: Requires 3x3 clear space; fruits in Spring & Summer.

crops.name: Creamy Avocado Tree
crops.description: Velvety Mesoamerican fruit mashed onto hearth toast with farmstead eggs.
crops.harvest_note: Requires 3x3 clear space; fruits in Summer.

crops.name: Blackberry Bush
crops.description: Compact 1x1 berry bush yielding dark bramble fruit for tarts and syrups.
crops.harvest_note: Regrows berries every 3 days across Summer.

crops.name: Bog Cranberry Bush
crops.description: Moisture-loving marsh bush yielding tart cranberries for roast meat glazes.
crops.harvest_note: Regrows berries every 3 days across Autumn.

crops.name: Hearth Climbing Rose
crops.description: Climbs wooden fences outside The Hearth, boosting Cozy Rating and yielding fragrant tea petals.
crops.harvest_note: Blooms along trellises in Spring & Summer.

crops.name: Rain-Shift Hydrangea
crops.description: Weather-reactive blooms shifting from rose-violet in sunshine to sapphire blue on rainy days.
crops.harvest_note: Cut blooms decorate tavern dining tables.

crops.name: Autumn Lantern Lily
crops.description: Drooping lantern-shaped blooms emitting warm amber light along autumn evening paths.
crops.harvest_note: Emits soft warm PointLight2D glow at night.

crops.name: Winter Snowdrop
crops.description: Delicate white ornamental bells blooming through Winter snow; tavern table vases boost guest tips.
crops.harvest_note: Frost-hardy Winter ornamental bloom.

crops.name: Starry Tulip
crops.description: Blooms in 4 random hues; bundled into birthday bouquets for 2x Heart Affection.
crops.harvest_note: Blooms after 5 days in Spring.

crops.name: Crimson Maple Bonsai
crops.description: Potted dwarf crimson maple placed on porches or inn rooms for permanent +12 Cozy Rating.
crops.harvest_note: Year-round potted ornamental bonsai.

crops.name: Sculpted Boxwood Hedge
crops.description: Evergreen trimmed hedge lining stone paths from Village Gate to The Hearth.
crops.harvest_note: Year-round evergreen path hedge.
